result:
I wrote `component.html` in the sales folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout hasn't been checked visually.

It follows DESIGN.md, and where the Look (v6) section differs from earlier sections, I used v6. It uses your exact copy, with the five rows in the order you gave.

- **Top of page:** a 6px blue bar runs across the full width. Below it are "PIPELINE" at 64px (Unbounded Light, caps) and a dark "New Deal" pill on the right. A 2px ink rule sits under the title row.
- **Search:** "Search deals" is an inline label with a 320px field next to it.
- **Table:**
  - It has a dark header row with white labels and 64px rows, with no card around it.
  - Company names are bold at 18px.
  - Values are blue, bold, right-aligned and use tabular numbers.
  - Stages are outlined tags, and "Won" is filled blue.
- **Self-contained:** the color tokens are inlined from `tokens.css`, there's no JavaScript, and the whole screen sits inside `#component` at 1280px wide.

- **New token:** DESIGN.md asks for a 64px title but has no token that size, so I added `--text-page` (4rem) in the file's token block. If you want it shared, it needs to go into `tokens.json`.
- **Fonts:** there are no font files in the folder, so the page falls back to the system sans-serif unless Unbounded and Archivo are installed. The title will look less distinctive than it should until those fonts are available. That matters for a customer demo.
